status: Historical proposed register with bounded later implementation receipts; not whole-public-API completion

coverage.claim: All 2,409 reconciled inventory IDs and 2,426 target rows retained. Implemented counts bounded SDK receipts, not full member/CLI closure or whole-public-API parity.

shared.mapping_authority: api-language-mappings.md (J01–J10), public-api-map-notes.md, and the exact language_mappings in this register

owner-validation.when: A live receiver or argument was invalidated by replacement/removal.
A live argument belongs to another owner and no explicit import was requested.
Host resource ceilings would be exceeded.
Explicit cancellation is observed before publication.

shared.execution: No ambient host I/O, native runtime, implicit network, clock, identity or fonts. Only supplied capabilities.
shared.schema: Every listed batch operation is a closed version-1 operation declaration, not a method-name evaluator. schema exposes these types and capabilities reports edit/read/preserve/reject without treating planned as implemented.
shared.naming: Neutral model snake_case retained. Operation options use camelCase; CLI flags use kebab-case. No blanket alias layer.

text_replace.cardinality: Exactly one of first/all/occurrence; literal cross-run Unicode matching with formatting preservation.

images.list: Occurrences by default; unique groups by content hash.
images.replace: file required; one selected occurrence unless all is explicit; shared changes a resource only by explicit intent.
images.size: width/height/fit contain|cover|stretch; one-dimension native-aspect default; no-dimension native DPI size.

command_contract.selectors: Opaque fingerprinted select token or simple one-based owner-scoped slide/shape/image/table/cell selectors, never mixed. Ambiguous/missing/stale mutation targets fail. Empty reads succeed; empty mutations need allowEmpty. Notes/layout/master/shared scope requires explicit intent.
command_contract.publication: Exactly one output or inPlace for mutation; create requires output. Existing explicit destinations need force; aliases of input need inPlace. Stdin cannot be inPlace. DryRun validates without publishing and needs no destination. One stdin consumer. Binary output cannot mix JSON/progress; diagnostics go to stderr.
command_contract.directories: outputDir uses adapter transactions or explicit allowPartialOutput and an exact output manifest; never silently delete existing files.
command_contract.json: Version-1 common envelope. Errors set ok=false/data=null/affected=0 before publication. Reads affected=0. Diff differences have ok=true/data.equal=false. Deterministic ordering and bounded diagnostics.
command_contract.batch: { version: 1, operations: [{ operation, arguments, receiver?, resultHandle? }] }. Each operation is a listed literal ID with its own closed argument schema. receiver is a typed owner/fingerprint handle, or a handle created earlier in the same batch. No strings are evaluated as methods or property paths.
command_contract.schema: schema accepts an optional command path and emits versioned operation, argument, result, enum and handle schemas, including every explicit batch row.
command_contract.capabilities: Report edit/read/preserve/reject plus exact supported subset, requirements and reasons. Planned rows are not runtime capabilities or implementation evidence.
command_contract.field_rules: Repeated scalar flags, unknown/inapplicable flags/JSON fields, conflicting selectors and repeated named limits are usage errors. Host ceilings can only be lowered.

src/pptx/shapes/shapetree.py:144-166.description: True if "turbo-add" mode is enabled. Read/Write.  EXPERIMENTAL: This feature can radically improve performance when adding large numbers (hundreds of shapes) to a slide. It works by caching the last shape ID used and incrementing that value to assign the next shape id. This avoids repeatedly searching all shape ids in the slide each time a new ID is required. Shape-id collisions can occur (causing a repair error on load) if more than one |Slide| object is used to interact with the same slide in the presentation. J01.model_names: Retain neutral source snake_case; no blanket camelCase alias layer.
J01.parameter_order: Source positional order; defaults remain optional positional arguments. Only keyword-only fields become a trailing typed options object with source field names.

reserved_parameter.reason: default is reserved in a TS positional parameter. Object option key default remains legal.

J01.construction: Presentation is an async callable factory. Unit/RGB/chart-data value constructors use new. Returned graph interfaces have no public raw-XML constructor.
J01.operation_options: camelCase; CLI kebab-case; unknown fields rejected.

J02.properties: Direct synchronous getters and assignments. Lazy allocation is not inherently XML mutation; creating getters are explicit mutating operations.
J02.ownership: Owner-bound live handles; cross-owner assignment fails without explicit import. Replacement invalidates old handles deterministically.
J02.arrays: Readonly snapshots unless a row says live membership. Array elements that are handles remain live.
J02.bytes: Fresh Uint8Array copy on return; inputs snapshotted at admission. Caller mutation cannot bypass validation.
J02.dates: Return Date copies so caller mutation cannot change document state.

J03.indexing: SDK numeric sequence lookup is zero-based and checked. CLI ordinals are one-based. Keyed placeholders use idx, never position.
J03.negative: Numeric property lookup rejects negative sequence positions; explicit at accepts negatives only in each collection profile. Negative placeholder keys remain keys.
J03.slice: Only collections marked slice_supported and RGB expose slice(start?, end?, step?). Omitted bounds depend on step direction; end exclusive; negatives normalized against length; clamp bounds; integer nonzero step; step=0 throws ValueError. Return readonly membership snapshot. No slices on other collections.
J03.iteration: Symbol.iterator returns an IterableIterator in source order; includes uses source value/element equality; reversed reverses traversal; count/index retain their source semantics and index miss throws ValueError.
J03.comparison: equals for explicit value/underlying-element comparison; JS reference equality is not overridden.
J03.strings: Category uses label/toString, RGB toString emits six uppercase hex digits; no copied Python scalar method library.

J04.enums: Immutable branded enum values with complete symbols, aliases, numeric/string values, name and XML metadata. Aliases reference the same enum definition. Equal-value named symbols remain addressable.
J04.conversion: from_xml and to_xml validate exact enum/XML members and reject return-only sentinels lacking XML values; validate does not permit arbitrary untyped numbers.
J04.immutability: Source mutable xml_value becomes immutable target metadata.
J04.typo: PERCENT_40 = 6, XML pct40; no ERCENT_40 public alias.
J04.media: OTHER and SOUND both retain numeric value 1; this collision is not independent evidence of audio classification.
J04.ole: PROG_ID dimensions and progId retained; icon filename denotes an original authored asset identifier, never a host path.

J05.numbers: Finite numbers only. Integer positions, enum backing numbers and EMUs require Number.isSafeInteger; reject coercion, nonfinite and unsafe values.
J05.rounding: Convert once to nearest integer, ties away from zero, before and after safe-range validation. Deliberate difference from source truncation and freeform ties-to-even.
J05.centipoints: Floor EMU / 127, including negatives; no bitwise coercion.
J05.rgb: Integer channels 0..255; from_string accepts exactly six ASCII hex digits and rejects trailing characters.
J05.null: Only types containing null admit null. undefined selects an optional default; never conflate null, false, 0 or empty string.
J05.core_dates: Valid UTC Date or absent null on read; setter requires valid Date. Serialize whole UTC seconds, discard milliseconds, never guess timezone.
J05.chart_dates: Use UTC calendar date; ignore time-of-day for spreadsheet category serials. Epoch 1899-12-31 with +1 after day 59 for 1900 leap bug, or 1904-01-01 without that adjustment. numeric_str_val emits one decimal place for date serials.
J05.core_strings: 255 Unicode code points maximum; absent strings read as empty string. Revision is explicit; save never increments it.

J06.input: Uint8Array | ByteSource | VfsPath; no Node streams or ambient path lookup. All input variants return the same Promise type.
J06.publication: Admission/validation before visible mutation; bounded serialization and atomic adapter publication. No hidden external fetch, decoding process or embedded activation.

image_characterization.dpi: Missing/invalid pair falls back to 72 per axis. Normalize finite numeric DPI to nearest ties-to-even integer as source characterization does, then use 72 when outside 1..2048. Geometry conversion independently uses shared ties-away rounding.
image_characterization.authority: Bounded format characterization or an explicit admitted capability; never a native decoder or implicit network. Other format-spec preserve/edit requirements remain additive.
image_characterization.sizing: No dimensions: pixel/DPI native size. One dimension: preserve aspect ratio. Both dimensions: explicit independent size. Placeholder insertion: cover crop. Finite visible-extent rules govern edits; existing negative/greater-than-one crop metadata stays readable.

J07.fonts: font_file is FontMetricsHandle, not a host font filename. Missing matching metrics fails unsupported-edit. Default requested family Calibri/max_size 18 does not grant font discovery.
J07.time: Only explicit context timestamp; omitted creation time remains absent. No wall-clock or author discovery.
J07.assets: Original default presentation, notes parts, poster and OLE icon bytes; never source templates or downloaded decks.
J07.links: Inert metadata only, including executable-looking action targets. No network, process, macro or OLE activation.

J08.transitive: Declared raises are not exhaustive. Shared owner, validation, resource, cancellation, admission, publication and format errors remain observable.

J09.xml: Bounded owned XML/package/line/path views defined in supporting_types and additional view rows; no lxml, arbitrary XPath, eval, callbacks, ambient authority or unrestricted package traversal.
J09.validation: Namespace/MCE-aware safe mutations and relationship consistency; DTD/external entities, traversal/unsafe URIs and host resolution rejected. Never return a raw host or loader object.

J10.text: Whole-object text setters/clear preserve source destructive scope; formatting-preserving text replace is separate.
J10.read_cli: inspect/list/get commands use noncreating queries. Creating model getters are explicitly mutating typed batch operations.
J10.commands: Plural images, tables, properties. Common literal replacement is text replace. Every advanced operation has a closed typed batch record; no dynamic method evaluator.

cases.given: new Inches(1), new Cm(2.54), new Mm(25.4), new Pt(72)
cases.expect: Each stores 914400 EMU.

cases.given: EMU conversion of +0.5 and -0.5; Centipoints accessor of Emu(-1)
cases.expect: Round to +1/-1; centipoints = -1.

cases.given: new RGBColor(18, 52, 86); from_string("123456"); from_string("1234567")
cases.expect: 123456; equal RGB value; final input rejected.

cases.given: NaN, Infinity, unsafe integer and fractional index
cases.expect: Typed failure before mutation.

cases.given: Three items; at(-1); slice(undefined, undefined, -1) on supported sequences
cases.expect: Last item; reverse membership snapshot; disallowed collections reject rather than emulate slicing.

cases.given: Placeholders keys 2,7,11
cases.expect: [7] is second; [1] throws KeyError; iteration retains key order.

cases.given: Table row/cell/column index -1 and chart point -1
cases.expect: IndexError, not the final item.

cases.given: Insert original 40x20 image into a 20x20 keyed placeholder
cases.expect: Cover crop centered with left/right crop 0.25; replacement keeps key; old handle throws InvalidHandleError.

cases.given: Insert chart/table then navigate replacement.chart/.table
cases.expect: PlaceholderGraphicFrame, not Chart/Table as the returned outer handle.

cases.given: Local dimension override removed with null
cases.expect: Effective inherited geometry returns without flattening master/layout properties.

cases.given: Two differently formatted runs "Coast" and "al"; text.replace find "Coastal" with "Harbor"
cases.expect: Literal cross-run replacement preserves unaffected formatting and links.

cases.given: Assign "North\nSouth\vBay" to frame.text
cases.expect: Two paragraphs; soft break inside second; prior runs replaced.

cases.given: Clear a text frame and a paragraph
cases.expect: Frame retains one empty paragraph; paragraph retains its paragraph properties.

cases.given: bold=null/false/true; size=null
cases.expect: Inheritance, explicit off/on and inherited size stay distinct.

cases.given: Original categories "Spring","Autumn" and values 4,null; replace_data
cases.expect: Caches, embedded worksheet cells and ranges agree; blank is not zero.

cases.given: Chart with no title; inspect versus chart_title access
cases.expect: Inspect retains bytes; creating getter adds one title; has_title=false removes title/text.

cases.given: Category number formats at chart, series and point levels
cases.expect: Nearest explicit format wins; data-label/tick-label number_format assignment disables source linkage.

cases.given: No fill, patterned fill, gradient fill and inherited background
cases.expect: type=null when absent; wrong-kind property access fails; background.fill materializes local NoFill only for creating access.

cases.given: Gradient positions 0,0.5,1; angle 90; brightness -1,0,1 and 1.01
cases.expect: Boundary values accepted, 1.01 brightness rejected; radial angle request fails.

cases.given: Absent color, RGB color and scheme color
cases.expect: rgb on absent/scheme raises PropertyAccessError; RGB succeeds; theme_color on RGB returns NOT_THEME_COLOR; absent theme_color fails.

cases.given: Line/font color getter on patterned fill; shadow.inherit=true
cases.expect: Color getter changes fill to solid; shadow assignment removes all local effects, including unrelated glow/reflection as documented.

cases.given: Authored PNG 144x72 at 72 DPI, omitted dimensions
cases.expect: Native extent 1828800x914400 EMU; one explicit dimension preserves aspect.

cases.given: Absent DPI or axis DPI outside 1..2048
cases.expect: 72 fallback on that axis; immutable input/output bytes; SHA-1 metadata separate from SHA-256 identity.

cases.given: Bytes, ByteSource and VfsPath admission; movie and OLE with omitted poster/icon
cases.expect: Always Promise; validate all inputs before visibility; original defaults; no native decoding, extraction, host lookup or execution.

cases.given: Two occurrences sharing media; replace one then extract both
cases.expect: Only selected occurrence rebound; original bytes survive on the other occurrence.

cases.given: Original 2x3 table; merge cells (0,0) through (1,1)
cases.expect: Origin span_width=2/span_height=2; spanned flags and text ordering preserved; logical grid iteration remains six cells.

cases.given: Split merged origin, then attempt overlapping/cross-table merge
cases.expect: Span cleared without reconstructing historical text; invalid merges fail atomically.

cases.given: External hyperlink, DTD/entity XML, ../ part URI, foreign owner node
cases.expect: Link remains inert; XML/path/owner attacks fail without network or host access.

cases.given: Cancelled or over-limit admission/publication
cases.expect: Typed error; preexisting input/destination unchanged; matching CLI 130/4.

cases.given: No timestamp or font metrics in context
cases.expect: No implicit time; fit_text fails visibly without host font discovery.

cases.given: 256 Unicode code-point string, invalid Date, valid 2030-01-02T03:04:05.987Z
cases.expect: Overlong string/invalid date rejected; valid date serializes 2030-01-02T03:04:05Z.

cases.given: Set revision=7 and save twice
cases.expect: Revision stays 7; absent dates remain null; author/time never discovered.

additional_drift.resolution: rgb returns RGBColor or PropertyAccessError; theme_color returns NOT_THEME_COLOR for existing non-scheme color and errors when absent.

additional_drift.finding: Inherited get retains master default annotation but notes collection dispatches a notes placeholder factory.
additional_drift.resolution: NotesSlidePlaceholder on hit; MasterPlaceholder explicit fallback or null on miss.

additional_drift.finding: FillFormat.type annotation omits the _NoneFill.type null result.
additional_drift.resolution: MSO_FILL_TYPE | null, with original no-fill acceptance.

whole_denominator_assessment.closure_rule: Every row requires checked actual export/returned acquisition, original tests for every observable obligation including absent upstream coverage, executable CLI route and explicit language/security mapping. Unsupported and not-currently-reconciled rows block full coverage. SDK-only bounded receipts do not establish a closed CLI member.
